description: This file defines a tool for reading files, including support for partial line reads and image processing notes. It includes functions to generate descriptions and create a read_file tool with configurable options.

classes.name: ReadFileToolOptions
classes.description: Interface defining options for creating the read_file tool, including partial reads, max concurrent reads, and image support.

methods.name: getReadFileSupportsNote
methods.description: Generates a support note string indicating whether image formats are supported.

methods.name: createReadFileTool
methods.description: Creates a configuration for the read_file tool, including description, parameters, and options based on input.
